hi.title: जीवन जैसा है
hi.text:
अतः जीवन का अर्थ है केवल खोजना
अपने लिए एक लय खोजते रहना,
अपने नाम के पर्याय रचकर
एक गीत गूँथने की कोशिश करना,
और आधे गुँथे
उसी बेसुरे गीत को गुनगुनाना।

ज्वार और भाटे में जो लय मिली
वह बेमेल हुई
धूप और छाँह की लय के साथ,
मिलन में, बिछोह में एक लय मिली
पर वह लय विलीन हो गई
जब ऋतु बदली, जब
उड़ गए घोंघिल पक्षी, जब झर गई
हरसिंगार।

अतः अपनी एक लय नहीं मिली
सीने में सँजोकर रखने को,
नहीं मिली एक लय, बैसाख की दोपहर में
छाँह खोजते-खोजते स्वयं को ढाढ़स देने को,
नहीं मिली एक लय किसी को
‘अपना मानकर दे रहा हूँ’ कहकर
उधार देने को।

यदि तुम जीवन में एक लय खोज रहे हो
या मेरी इस कविता में, तो खोजते रहो।
मिल भी जाए तो मुझसे कहना मत, केवल
अकेली साँझ में गाकर सुनाना
राह भटके चिड़िया के बच्चे को,
या उस हवा में बहा देना वह लय, जो आजकल भूलकर भी
मेरे घर की ओर नहीं आती।

जीवन का अर्थ है बाकी सारी लयों का मोह छोड़कर
चलो, अपनी लय खोजते रहें।

en.title: Life as It Is
en.text:
Thus life means only searching
continuing to search for a rhythm of one’s own,
creating synonyms for one’s name
and trying to weave a song,
and humming that half-woven,
out-of-tune song.

The rhythm found in the tide’s rise and ebb
proved out of step
with the rhythm of sunlight and shade,
a rhythm was found in meeting and parting
but that rhythm faded
when the season changed, when
the openbill storks flew away, when
the night-flowering jasmine fell.

Thus no rhythm of one’s own was found
to store beneath the breast,
no rhythm found, in a Baisakh afternoon,
to console oneself while searching for shade,
no rhythm found to lend someone
with the words,
‘I give this because you are my own.’

If you are searching for a rhythm in life
or in this poem of mine, keep searching.
Even if you find it, do not tell me; only
sing it, on a lonely evening,
to a fledgling that has lost its way,
or let that rhythm drift upon the wind that nowadays
does not come towards my house even by mistake.

Life means letting go of the lure of every other rhythm—
come, let us keep searching for our own.

or.title: ସରହଦ
or.text:
ଶୀତ ଋତୁରେ
ବାସନ ଝଣଝଣ ହୁଏ
ଯେବେ ସୋରିଷ ଶାଗରେ
ଅଗଣା ମହକି ଉଠେ
କେଉଁଠି ରୁଟି ଉପରେ ଲହୁଣି ଏମିତି ତରଳେ
ଦୂରେ କେଉଁଠି ଘରମାନଙ୍କ ଭିଡ଼ରେ
ନିଃଶବ୍ଦରେ ଖରା ଓହ୍ଲାଇଛି ଯେମିତି

ଅନ୍ଧ ସରହଦ ବାକ୍‌ହୀନ ରେଖାମାନଙ୍କର
ଓଜନ ବୋହି ଠିଆ ହୋଇଛି
ଦୃଷ୍ଟି ଓ ଶ୍ୱାସ ତଥାପି ସ୍ୱାଧୀନ
ଗତ ବର୍ଷାରେ ଭାସି ଆସିଥିବା ଏ ବୀଜ
ଏଠି ଘର ଆଗରେ ଅଟକି ଯାଇଥିଲା ବୋଧେ
ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ଫୁଲ ଆସିଛି
ଏହାକୁ ଭାଗ କରି ବାଣ୍ଟିବା କେମିତି
ଏହାର ସୁଗନ୍ଧରେ ଝରକା ଖୋଲେ
ମୋ ଆଖିଠାରୁ
ଆକାଶଛୁଆଁ ଦେବଦାରୁ ଯାଏଁ
ଏମିତି କୌଣସି ପ୍ରଯୁକ୍ତିର ଡୋର ନାହିଁ ଯାହା
ପବନକୁ ବାନ୍ଧିପାରିବ
ସୁଗନ୍ଧକୁ ରୋକିପାରିବ
ମୁଁ ପ୍ରଭାତୀ ସମୀର, ଛୁଇଁ ଗଲେ ଅନୁଭବ ହେବ
ଶ୍ୱାସରେ ଭରିନେଲେ ଜୀବନର ଅନୁଭୂତି ହେବ।

en.title: Border
en.text:
In the cold season
utensils ring
when mustard greens
scent the courtyard
somewhere butter melts upon a roti as though
far away among a crowd of houses
sunlight had descended without a sound

The blind border stands bearing
the weight of speechless lines
yet sight and breath are free
this seed, floating in the last rain,
perhaps became caught here before the house
and has now flowered
how shall we divide it into shares?
its fragrance opens a window
from my eyes
to the sky-reaching deodar
there is no technological cord that
can bind the wind
can stop fragrance
I am the morning breeze: when I touch you, you feel me
breathe me in and you feel life.

or.title: ନା ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଅଛି, ନା ଅଭିମାନ
or.text:
ନା ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଅଛି, ନା ଅଭିମାନ।
ଜଣେ ସୈନିକର ପତ୍ନୀ ହୋଇଥିବାର ଗର୍ବ ଅଛି ମୋର।
କିନ୍ତୁ ହୃଦୟ ତ ଜଣେ ନାରୀର....

ହୃଦୟର ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଣାର ଅବସ୍ଥା ଲୁଚାଇବି କେମିତି।
ବେଶ୍ ସହଜରେ ହସିହସି,
ମିଛ କହି ଚାଲିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।।

ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା କରି କହିଯାଇଥିଲ..
ଶୀଘ୍ର ଫେରି ଆସିବି ମୁଁ।
ଲାଲ ଚୂଡ଼ି ପିନ୍ଧାଇଦେବି ମୁଁ।
ଅପେକ୍ଷା କରିବ ତୁମେ,
ନିଜର ଓ ଆପଣାର ଲୋକଙ୍କ ଯତ୍ନ ନେବ ତୁମେ।।

ବେଶ୍ ସହଜରେ ହସିହସି,
ମିଛ କହି ଚାଲିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।।

ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କୁ କହିଥିଲ,
ବହୁତ ଖେଳଣା ଆଣିବ ତୁମେ।
ବୁଢ଼ୀ ମାଆକୁ ଅତି ସହଜରେ ଗାଁକୁ ନେବାର ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା କରିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।
ମାଆ କେବେ ଭାବି ନ ଥିଲା,
ତ୍ରିରଙ୍ଗାରେ ଗୁଡ଼ାଇ ହୋଇ ଆସିବ,
ଆଉ ଦିନେ ଗାଁକୁ ନେବ ପୁଅ..

ବେଶ୍ ସହଜରେ ହସିହସି,
ମିଛ କହିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।।

କର୍ତ୍ତବ୍ୟ ପାଳନର ବେଳ ଯେବେ ଆସିଲା,
ନିଜ ଛାତି ଠୋକି
ଝାମ୍ପି ପଡ଼ିଲ ଯୁଦ୍ଧକ୍ଷେତ୍ରରେ,
ହସିହସି ଦେଶ ପାଇଁ ସହିଦ ହେଲ।।
ତ୍ରିରଙ୍ଗାକୁ କଲ ନିଜ ତୀର,
ତୁମେ ନିଜ ଦେଶର ବୀର....

ବେଶ୍ ସହଜରେ ହସିହସି,
ମିଛ କହିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।।

ସବୁ ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା, ସଂକଳ୍ପ ଭୁଲି,
ଆଖିରେ ଦେଇଗଲ ମିଛ ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା।
ଆମେ ସରଳ ନିରୀହ,
ତୁମ ବିନା ଅଧା ହୋଇଗଲୁ....

ବେଶ୍ ସହଜରେ ହସିହସି,
ମିଛ କହିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।।

ନା ଅଭିଯୋଗ ଅଛି, ନା ଅଭିମାନ,
ଜଣେ ସୈନିକର ପତ୍ନୀ ହେବାର ଗର୍ବ ଅଛି।
କିନ୍ତୁ ହୃଦୟ ତ ଜଣେ ନାରୀର....

ପିଲାମାନଙ୍କ ପ୍ରତିଜ୍ଞା ଭୁଲିଗଲ ତୁମେ,
ବୁଢ଼ୀ ମାଆର ଲୁହକୁ ଗାଁକୁ ନେଇଗଲ ତୁମେ।
ଧଳା ରଙ୍ଗ ମୋତେ ଉପହାର ଦେଇଗଲ ତୁମେ।।

ବେଶ୍ ସହଜରେ ହସିହସି,
ମିଛ କହିଯାଇଥିଲ ତୁମେ।।

en.title: Neither Complaint nor Grievance
en.text:
I have neither complaint nor grievance.
I am proud to be a soldier’s wife.
But mine is a woman’s heart....

How can I hide the state of this aching heart?
So easily, smiling,
you went away telling a lie.

You promised as you left..
I shall return soon.
I shall put red bangles on your wrists.
Wait for me,
look after yourself and our loved ones.

So easily, smiling,
you went away telling a lie.

You told the children
you would bring so many toys.
So easily you promised to take your old mother to the village.
Your mother never imagined
her son would come wrapped in the tricolour
and someday take her to the village..

So easily, smiling,
you told a lie as you left.

When the time came to fulfil your duty,
beating your chest,
you charged into the battlefield,
smiling, you became a martyr for your country.
You made the tricolour your arrow,
you are your country’s hero....

So easily, smiling,
you told a lie as you left.

Forgetting every promise and intention,
you left false promises in our eyes.
We are simple folk,
left half ourselves without you....

So easily, smiling,
you told a lie as you left.

I have neither complaint nor grievance,
I am proud to be a soldier’s wife.
But mine is a woman’s heart....

You forgot your promises to the children,
you took your old mother’s tears to the village.
You left the colour white as your gift to me.

So easily, smiling,
you told a lie as you left.

or.title: ଅନୁଭୂତି
or.text:
ସଫାସୁତୁରା ପଥଟିଏ ଆମର ଦରକାର
ପଥପ୍ରଦର୍ଶକଙ୍କୁ ଏବେ ଏକଥା କହିବା ଦରକାର

ପ୍ରେମରେ କଥାବାର୍ତ୍ତା କେହି କରେନାହିଁ
ଅତୀତ କାଳର ସେହି ସମସ୍ୱର ସାଥୀ ଦରକାର

ଏ ସୁନ୍ଦର ପୃଥିବୀର ଉପହାର ମିଳିଛି
ଏହାଠାରୁ ଅଧିକ ଆଉ କ'ଣ ଆମର ଦରକାର

ଫୁଲ ପତ୍ରରେ ମହକୁଥାଉ ଆମ ଧରା
ତା' ସୁରକ୍ଷା ପାଇଁ ପାଦ ବଢ଼ାଇବା ଦରକାର

ଯାହାଦ୍ୱାରା ଦୁନିଆରେ ନିଜ ପରିଚୟ ଗଢ଼ିବ
କିଛି ଭିନ୍ନ କଥା ଆମକୁ ଭାବିବା ଦରକାର

କିଏ ଗରିମା ତାକୁ କହିବ, ଏବେ କୁହ
ତୁମ ଦୁଃଖରେ ପୀଡ଼ିତ ଜଣକୁ ଔଷଧ ଦରକାର

en.title: Feeling
en.text:
We need a clean, clear road
we should now tell our guide this

No one speaks with love
we need that kindred companion of bygone days

We have received this beautiful world as a gift
what more than this could we need?

May our earth remain fragrant with flowers and leaves
we must step forward to protect it

So that we may make our own mark in the world
we need to think a little differently

Who, Garima, will tell that person? Say now:
the one sick with grief for you needs medicine

or.title: କାଶ୍
or.text:
କାଶ୍
ନ ଥାଆନ୍ତା ସରହଦର ଏ ପାଚେରି
ମାଟି ପାଣିରେ ନ ଥାଆନ୍ତା ରେଖା
ଆକାଶ ପରି ଖୋଲା ଥାଆନ୍ତା ଏ ଜଗତ
ଧର୍ମର ଊର୍ଦ୍ଧ୍ୱରେ ଥାଆନ୍ତା କେବଳ ମଣିଷ।

କାଶ୍
ଭୟ ବିନା ଝିଅମାନେ ଉଡ଼ାଣ ଭରୁଥାଆନ୍ତେ
ପିନ୍ଧିବା ଓଢ଼ିବାରେ ଚିନ୍ତା ନ ଥାଆନ୍ତା
ମନ ଚାହୁଁଥିବା କାମ କରନ୍ତେ, ସମୟର ବନ୍ଧନ ନ ଥାଆନ୍ତା
ବୁଝାଯାଉଥାଆନ୍ତା ଭାବନା ଓ ଅନ୍ତର୍ମନ।

କାଶ୍
ଗୋଟିଏ ଘର ପରିବାର ଖଣ୍ଡଖଣ୍ଡ ନ ହୁଅନ୍ତା
ହାତରେ ନିଜ ନିଜ ପରଦା ଧରି
ସମ୍ପର୍କଠାରୁ ଦୂରେ ନ ପଳାନ୍ତେ ପିଲାଏ, ବଡ଼ମାନେ
ପ୍ରେମର ମହତ୍ତ୍ୱ ଏବେ ସେମାନେ ବୁଝନ୍ତେ।

କାଶ୍
ସମାଜରୁ ଶତ୍ରୁତା, ଧର୍ମ, ଜାତିର
ବିଦ୍ୱେଷ ଏବେ ଲିଭିଯାଆନ୍ତା
ଏ ଧରା କେବେ ଖିଲିଖିଲି ହସନ୍ତା
ବସୁଧୈବ କୁଟୁମ୍ବକମ୍‌ର ପରମ୍ପରା
ହୋଇଯାଆନ୍ତା।

en.title: If Only
en.text:
If only
there were no walls of borders
no lines upon land and water
this world were open like the sky
beyond religion, there were simply human beings.

If only
daughters took flight without terror
untroubled about what to wear or cover themselves with
free to do as they wished, without restrictions of time
their feelings and inner lives were understood.

If only
one household, one family were not split into pieces
each holding a screen in their hands
children and elders did not flee from relationships
and now understood the value of love.

If only
from society, enmity and the hostility of religion and caste
would now be erased
this earth might laugh freely someday
and the tradition of the world as one family
come to be.
